Soporte.descripcion: Tell us what is happening with your equipment. We help you find the next step, with remote or on-site assistance depending on your situation.
Soporte.foto: Our office at Plaza El Bosque, Atenas
Soporte.mensaje: Hello, SG Solutions. I need technical support for my equipment.
Soporte.ayudaTitulo: What do you need help with?
Soporte.ayudaTexto: Choose a topic and tell us the details on WhatsApp.
Soporte.texto2: Questions about your surveillance or alarm system.
Soporte.temaMensaje: Hello, SG Solutions. I need help with: {tema}.
Soporte.paso0Texto: Describe the equipment, the issue and when you first noticed it.
Soporte.paso1Texto: We determine whether remote support, service at our premises or an on-site visit is appropriate.
Soporte.paso2Texto: We confirm the scope and terms before carrying out the work.
Soporte.pregunta0: Can I request support without a plan?
Soporte.respuesta0: Yes. Tell us about your situation so we can review the scope and prepare a service proposal.
Soporte.respuesta1: Depending on the issue, we can arrange remote or in-person assistance. Our team confirms the approach after reviewing your request.
Soporte.pregunta2: What information should I have ready?
Soporte.respuesta2: The equipment type and model, a description of the issue and any error messages. Do not share passwords on WhatsApp.

AdminCatalogo.descripcion: Edit your selection and review prices before saving. Changes are applied together.
AdminCatalogo.imagen: Image: HTTPS URL or local path
AdminCatalogo.precioManual: Final manual price (CRC, VAT included; optional)
AdminCatalogo.categoriaNota: Move products to another category before removing this one.
AdminCatalogo.formula: USD cost × (exchange rate + adjustment) × (1 + VAT / 100) × (1 + markup / 100). Then prices round upward: ₡500 for accessories, ₡1,000 for mid-range products and ₡5,000 for larger equipment.
AdminCatalogo.manualNota: A manual price overrides the formula and is respected as the exact final price. Leave blank to calculate automatically.
AdminCatalogo.notaGuardar: Review products and prices before saving.
AdminCatalogo.validacion: Check all fields: both languages are required, amounts must be valid and categories must exist.
AdminCatalogo.sinPermiso: Your account cannot edit the catalog.
AdminCatalogo.noDisponible: Catalog administration requires a configured database with its migration applied.
AdminCatalogo.conflicto: Another administrator saved changes. Reload before continuing.
AdminCatalogo.error: Unable to save changes. Your edits are still here.
AdminCatalogo.integracionTexto: Automatic updates preserve your text, categories and manual prices. Activation requires IWS credentials and server configuration.
AdminCatalogo.sinSincronizacion: No import has been recorded yet.
AdminCatalogo.revisionPrecio: The supplier cost changed by more than 30%. Review it before updating the selling price.

Casos.descripcion: Explore some of the projects where we have supported our clients with solutions designed around their operations.
Casos.texto0: Connectivity and video surveillance in one project. At Servicentro San Juan, SG Solutions integrated the network infrastructure and IP camera system, with equipment organized in cabinets and a screen to view the monitored areas.
Casos.situacion0: The project covered business connectivity and a camera system for monitoring its different areas.
Casos.respuesta0: The network infrastructure, communications cabinet and IP camera system with centralized viewing were implemented.
Casos.valorado0: Connected operations and a central view of monitored areas through a system prepared for support and maintenance.
Casos.alt0_0: Exterior of Servicentro San Juan with the SG Solutions technical support vehicle.

Casos.titulo1: Point of sale and technology infrastructure
Casos.texto1: Technology supporting pharmacy service. The ECOFARMA project brings together a point-of-sale station with a barcode scanner, receipt printer and cash drawer, alongside a wall-mounted cabinet for technology equipment.
Casos.situacion1: Counter service and organization of the pharmacy’s technology equipment.
Casos.respuesta1: A station with a monitor, keyboard, barcode scanner, receipt printer and cash drawer, alongside a wall-mounted equipment cabinet.
Casos.valorado1: The photographs show the service station and cabinet installed at the store.

Casos.titulo2: Point-of-sale stations and IP surveillance camera system
Casos.texto2: Point-of-sale stations and IP surveillance for Eco Mini Market. Our team worked on installing the service stations and the store’s camera system, bringing together the equipment and peripherals used in the business’s operations.
Casos.situacion2: The store required point-of-sale stations and IP video surveillance to support its operations.
Casos.respuesta2: The point-of-sale equipment was installed and configured along with the IP cameras intended for store surveillance.
Casos.valorado2: Equipment ready for operation and a surveillance solution prepared according to the establishment’s needs.
